title: Upper body flex
summary:
A little welcoming pose for all the new subscribers who have graced this channel with their support recently.
My goal is to help people achieve their full potential, both spiritually and physically, and to promote natural bodybuilding. 
In this community, we try to help and encourage each other, no matter what level of development we might be at. We also support staying irreverent, never worshipping or idolizing anyone and keeping it fun. If you feel lost, follow the lead of the OG subscribers,
